# September 2026

Term started on the 7th. The week was rewritten around it: the long blocks moved to the weekend mornings, and the evenings got lighter. September is the month that proves the new week holds.

# Goals

Educational

- [ ] Maths: a good mark on the first test
- [ ] Coding: one small program a week
- [x] Miss no class
- [ ] Read every evening
- [ ] The weekend blocks run four weekends out of four

Financial

- [x] No side job during term
- [x] End the month at or above the planned balance

Personal

- [ ] In bed by 23h00
- [ ] Cardio four times a week
- [ ] A long walk with a friend every Sunday
- [x] No side projects during term

# Review

The week held: on the days I marked, most of the study blocks were done and no class was missed. The evenings did not: sleep held 7 nights of 24, cardio 3 times out of 10, and the Sunday history hour never happened. The first test gave 15 in maths, under the 17 aimed at. October keeps the week and changes one thing: the phone stays out of the room.
